blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — In a series of coordinated law enforcement operations conducted across the province from November 12 to 14, police units apprehended 10 wanted individuals, highlighted by the capture of a provincial topmost wanted person. The operations were executed by various municipal police stations, including Manolo Fortich, Impasugong, San Fernando, Quezon, Valencia City, Malaybalay City, Don Carlos, Lantapan, and Libona, operating in close coordination with the Provincial Intelligence Unit and provincial mobile force companies. Among those arrested was 22-year-old Marco Pagar Ochate—listed as a Provincial Level Top 5 Most Wanted Person—who was collared in Manolo Fortich on Nov. 14 […]...
